name: Korentin
text: Korentin is the prelate of Quimper in the Breton story of the sunken city of Ys. He owns a fish that he can eat on one day and find whole again on the next. The wonder marks him as a keeper of endless supply.

attributes.attribute: bishop of Quimper in the legend of Ys
